home.title: Digital Activation
home.tagline: Genuine activation keys for software and operating systems, delivered instantly and covered by the Golden Warranty.
home.heroHeadline: Genuine activation keys, delivered in minutes
home.heroBody: Windows, Office, Adobe, antivirus, design and developer tools — licensed at source, delivered automatically after payment, and covered by the Golden Warranty.
home.trustGenuineBody: Every key comes from a licensed distributor and activates on the vendor's own servers. No used keys, no workarounds.
home.trustDeliveryBody: The key reaches your inbox and your account the moment payment clears. Nobody has to be at a desk.
home.trustWarrantyBody: If a key stops working inside its licence term, we replace it. The cover is written on the product page, not promised in a chat.
home.trustSupportBody: Help with installation and activation, from the same team that sold you the key.
home.categoriesBody: Each category shows what is actually in the catalogue.
home.bestSellersBody: Ordered by real purchases, not by our pick.
home.postsBody: Short pieces answering what gets asked before a purchase: which edition fits, and how it activates.
home.stepsTitle: From payment to activation in three steps
home.step1Body: Pick the term and the device count on the product page. The price updates before you buy.
home.step2Body: Pay securely at checkout. No account needed.
home.step3Body: The key arrives with the activation steps for your product, and stays in your account.
home.faq1A: Yes. Every key is sourced from a licensed distributor and activates directly against the vendor — Microsoft, Adobe and the rest. Each product page states the activation method exactly: a retail key, a binding to an account, or a redeem code.
home.faq2A: As soon as payment clears, to your email and to the licences page in your account. Each product page states its expected delivery time; some shared accounts take longer because they are prepared by hand.
home.faq3Q: What does the Golden Warranty cover?
home.faq3A: If a key stops working within the stated licence term, we replace it at no cost. It does not cover repeated hardware changes on OEM licences, or an account suspended for breaching the vendor's terms. Covered products carry the Golden Warranty badge on their page.
home.faq4Q: Does a licence work on more than one device?
home.faq4A: It depends on the licence you choose. Every product states the device count plainly — one, three, five, or unlimited — and the price moves with it.
home.faq5Q: What if I need help installing it?
home.faq5A: Activation steps arrive with the key, and support will walk you through it if something fails. Help with installation and activation is included in the price.

contact.faqBody: Quick answers to the most common questions our customers ask.
contact.sla: Average reply time: Under 2 hours (24h max)
contact.lede: Have a pre-purchase question, need help activating your licence, or looking for business quotes? Message us and we will be delighted to assist you.
contact.heading: Contact Us — We Are Here to Help
contact.faq5Q: How long does customer support take to reply?
contact.faq4A: If a technical problem on your own machine is preventing activation, our team can help you over a remote session using a tool such as AnyDesk, at no charge.
contact.faq4Q: Can your support team help me remotely on my PC?
contact.faq3A: Yes, absolutely. Choose "Business sales" in the form specifying the product and quantities needed, and our B2B team will reply with a tailored quotation and official invoice.
contact.faq3Q: Do you sell to businesses with certified tax invoices?
contact.faq2A: Your key and instructions arrive immediately in your email upon order completion. You can also view it anytime on your "My licences" page by logging in with a magic link.
contact.faq2Q: Where do I find my licence key after purchasing?
contact.faq1A: Select "Activation problem" in the form above or message us directly on WhatsApp with your order number. We advise not repeating incorrect attempts repeatedly until our team verifies it and gives you the exact fix or immediate replacement.
contact.faq1Q: My key is not working or shows an error — what is the fastest step?
contact.metaDescription: Reach us through the form, or message directly on WhatsApp, Telegram or email. We reply within 2 hours, 24 hours at the latest.
contact.metaTitle: Contact Us — Technical Support & Customer Service | Digital Activation
contact.faq5A: We reply to form and email messages within {hours} hours at the latest, usually sooner. WhatsApp is the fastest way to reach us.
